1. level-headed /ˈlevəl ˌhedɪd/
Definition: Calm and rational when facing difficulties or stressful situations
Example: Even when the project deadline was moved up by two weeks, Sarah remained level-headed and organized the team efficiently.
Word family: level-headedness (noun), level-headedly (adverb)
Synonyms: calm, composed, rational, sensible, steady

2. Decipher /dɪˈsaɪfər/
Definition: To convert secret codes or encrypted messages back into readable text
Example: Cryptographers work to decipher enemy communications during wartime
